name: Witch's Lounge
description:
About This Game

A Lane-Based Rhythm Game Where You Draw Magic Circles to the Beat with Witches

In an age where magic has become an everyday technology, the magic circle therapy shop "Witch's Lounge" is reopening its doors as a magical stage performance venue.
Now burdened with an enormous debt and unexpectedly promoted to manager, you'll work alongside a cast of unique witches to put on unforgettable performances.

Well then... shall we open for business?

Lead the Witches to a Perfect Performance!

  • As the manager of Witch's Lounge, you'll issue commands to the witches in time with the music to help them draw magical circles.

  • Hit Tap, Direction, and High Tension markers with perfect timing, and the witches will complete beautiful magic circles on stage.

Win Over the Audience with Spectacular Shows

  • Perform over 80 songs to captivate your audience.

  • The better your performance, the more satisfied your customers will be.

  • Flawless shows attract more fans and help Witch's Lounge continue to grow.

Aim for the Perfect Performance

  • No one starts out perfect. Practice each song again and again to achieve your best results!

  • Master every performance to earn beautiful trophies.

  • You might even discover a few special surprises along the way!

Everyday Life with the Witches

  • Meet Karen, the dependable acting manager; Yuna, a laid-back but incredibly talented witch; and Amber, an enthusiastic rookie who always gives it her all.

  • Spend time with these charming witches and gradually uncover the story of Witch's Lounge.

■ Story ■

***

"Magic Circle Therapy" is a new business that emerged in an era where magic has become commonplace.

By drawing magical circles, practitioners cast useful spells on those who seek magical assistance.

The effects vary widely—from relieving fatigue to temporarily boosting physical strength.

Its convenience quickly made Magic Circle Therapy popular all over the world,

and our shop was just one of countless Magic Circle Therapy establishments.

But as competition intensified, fewer and fewer customers came.

To survive, the shop took things one step further by combining therapy with show business.

Magic circles, music, and dance came together to create dazzling stage performances.

Cute witches danced, customers left happier than ever, fans started to gather, and business began to thrive.

With enough success, conquering the entire Magic Circle Therapy industry no longer seemed impossible.

...That was all the explanation I got.

On my very first day after getting hired at Witch's Lounge, I unexpectedly became its manager...
along with inheriting an enormous debt.

All that remained at the shop were the owner, a few maintenance staff, and a group of mages who had somehow ended up performing as witches.

...And me.

And so, as the manager of [Witch's Lounge], I found myself carrying the fate of the shop on my shoulders.

***

■ Character Introduction ■

Lamia Karen

A small but dependable witch. One of the founding members of Witch's Lounge who has supported the owner as acting manager since the days of the original therapy shop.

Yoo na

A lazy but exceptionally capable witch who always gets the job done. Unless she's absolutely needed, she's usually relaxing in the break room.

Amber Springfield

A clumsy rookie witch who still has much to learn about both magic and performing, but never lacks enthusiasm.

Her favorite hobby is enjoying a good drink.
short_desc: Welcome to the Witch’s Lounge! Witch's Lounge is a rail-style rhythm game where you draw magic circles on a stage in sync with the music. Complete magic circles to the rhythm of the music and cast helpful spells for the people. A charming stage awaits, where cute witches and music come together.
